messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: BrightConf Ops <ops@brightconf.com>, Asha Reddy <asha@codewave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Subject: One-off: lightning-talk attendee credit makeup and approval

Hi Asha / BrightConf team —

Quick note from yesterday's lightning track: we had an unexpected +8 walk-ins for the CodeWave slot (great turnout — congrats!). Per our promo plan we intended to gift trial credits to registered attendees; the extra attendees were not captured in the original promo export, so they didn't receive codes.

Request: can we approve a one-off allocation of promo credits for those 8 additional attendees? Proposal below:
- 3 months trial access (equivalent to 2,000 tokens) converted to one-time "starter" promo code per person (8 codes)
- In total ~16k token-equivalent; suggested account cap: 1 code per attendee, expire in 30 days

I attached the attendee_list_aug24.csv (names + emails highlighted) and a quick exported ledger snippet (credit_ledger_export_Q3.csv) so finance can see the delta.

Would like Marissa's sign-off on the accounting side and Kimberly to confirm distribution method (console code batch vs. single-use codes). If possible, can we process this today so marketing can follow up with a thank-you email tomorrow?

Thanks — Mark

Markus Klein
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, BrightConf Ops <ops@brightconf.com>, Asha Reddy <asha@codewave.io>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: One-off: lightning-talk attendee credit makeup and approval

Thanks for the heads up, Markus —

Approve the one-off allocation with the following guardrails:
- Limit: 8 starter codes as proposed (1 per attendee)
- Per-company cap remains in effect; if any single company is receiving >2 of the 8 codes, let me know and we'll rerun the cap exception process
- Add a column to the attached attendee_list_aug24.csv noting "promo_code_assigned" and the code id for audit

I took a quick look at the ledger export — the delta is modest and fine to absorb under the marketing promo budget. Kimberly: please confirm you have the console workflow to generate single-use starter codes (expiry 30 days) and will add the audit column back to Marissa once codes are assigned.

If you need a formal PO or accounting entry, I'll ask Finance to create an internal memo (won't block issuance today).

Marissa Cole
Growth Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
